channel.title: XFree.in — Free Developer, SEO & AI Micro-Tools
channel.description: Published browser-based developer, SEO, AI, and converter micro-tools with clear processing disclosures.

item.title: XML Sitemap Generator & Validator
item.description: Generate valid Google & Bing XML sitemaps with priority, changefreq, lastmod, and automatic chunking for large link sets.
item.content:encoded:
XML Sitemap Generator & Validator

Converts lists of web URLs into schema-compliant XML sitemaps with proper XML escaping and sitemap index generation.

item.title: Robots.txt Generator & User-Agent Rule Tester
item.description: Create valid robots.txt directives for search engine crawlers, test path allowance rules, and specify XML sitemaps.
item.content:encoded:
Robots.txt Generator & User-Agent Rule Tester

Builds RFC 9309 compliant robots.txt files with Allow/Disallow rule groups, crawl-delay directives, and sitemap references.

item.title: Meta Tag & Open Graph Social Card Preview
item.description: Generate meta title tags, meta descriptions, and Open Graph / Twitter Cards with real-time Google SERP and social card previews.
item.content:encoded:
Meta Tag & Open Graph Social Card Preview

Constructs HTML meta tags for title, description, canonical URL, og:title, og:image, and twitter:card with length character count validation.

item.title: Schema Markup Generator (JSON-LD Structured Data)
item.description: Generate valid Schema.org JSON-LD structured data for WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, Article, and Breadcrumbs.
item.content:encoded:
Schema Markup Generator (JSON-LD Structured Data)

Generates rich snippet structured data in valid JSON-LD format with form validation and Google Rich Results compliance checks.

item.title: JSON / XML Formatter, Validator & Tree Viewer
item.description: Format, validate, repair, minify, and inspect JSON/XML data with interactive tree views and error location diagnostics.
item.content:encoded:
JSON / XML Formatter, Validator & Tree Viewer

Parses JSON and XML payloads, identifies syntax errors with line/column markers, provides formatting, minification, and visual tree hierarchy.

item.title: Regex Tester & Interactive Match Explainer
item.description: Test regular expressions live with match group breakdown, string replacement previews, and flags (g, i, m).
item.content:encoded:
Regex Tester & Interactive Match Explainer

Evaluates regex patterns against sample text in real-time, showing match groups, indices, and string replacement outputs.

item.title: Bulk URL Extractor & Sitemap Generator
item.description: Extract URLs from massive raw text or HTML, clean, deduplicate, filter by domain, and generate valid XML Sitemaps with Sitemap-Index splitting.
item.content:encoded:
Bulk URL Extractor & Sitemap Generator

Parses raw text, HTML, or logs to isolate HTTP/HTTPS URLs, deduplicate them, filter by domain, and export Google-compliant XML Sitemaps.

item.title: Cron Expression Generator & Human Translator
item.description: Generate standard 5-part cron schedule expressions, view plain-English explanations, and calculate upcoming execution times.
item.content:encoded:
Cron Expression Generator & Human Translator

Translates cron syntax into human-readable sentences and calculates exact future execution timestamps.

item.title: Base64 Encoder/Decoder & JWT Token Inspector
item.description: Safely encode and decode Base64 strings, UTF-8 text, Base64URL parameters, and inspect OAuth JWT headers, payloads, and claims.
item.content:encoded:
Base64 Encoder/Decoder & JWT Token Inspector

Decodes JWT headers and payload claims without transmitting tokens to external servers. Supports UTF-8 safe Base64 and Base64URL encoding/decoding.

item.title: URL Slug Generator & Campaign UTM Parameter Builder
item.description: Clean title strings into SEO-friendly URL slugs, and build campaign URLs with UTM parameters (source, medium, campaign, term, content).
item.content:encoded:
URL Slug Generator & Campaign UTM Parameter Builder

Converts strings into lowercase, hyphen-separated clean URL slugs while stripping special characters. Appends validated Google Analytics UTM parameters to base URLs.
